FICTIONAL QA DOCUMENT - NOT LEGAL ADVICE OR A TEMPLATE FOR SIGNING

An accepted amendment overrides the original scope

C1. Parties: Quiet Harbor Copy and Moss Finch Learning. All identities, messages and acceptance records are fictional demonstration data.

C2. Original agreement accepted November 14, 2026: USD 800 for 10 estimated hours. Deliverables are two newsletters of up to 600 words each. Original delivery date: November 20, 2026.

C3. One consolidated revision round for each included deliverable is included, provided it stays within the approved audience, offer and outline. New interviews, factual research and translation are excluded. The included revision rounds have not been used.

C4. Amendment A1, proposed November 15: remove the second newsletter and replace it with one landing page of up to 600 words. Four estimated newsletter hours are removed and four landing-page hours are added. Only one newsletter remains. Total fee stays USD 800 and total estimate stays 10 hours. Delivery becomes November 22, 2026.

C5. Explicit fictional acceptance of A1 on November 15: client: "I accept A1: one newsletter and one landing page, USD 800 total, delivery November 22." Freelancer: "Confirmed, I accept those exact A1 terms." A1 is the current agreed amendment; C2 describes the superseded scope/date where inconsistent.

C6. Amendment A2, proposed November 16 only: add a third deliverable for USD 200, delivery November 23. Client reply: "Thanks, I will review it." The freelancer has not received acceptance of A2. A2 is not part of the current agreement.

C7. Any later scope, price or date change must identify the revised deliverables and terms and be explicitly accepted by both parties. A new estimate or draft reply alone does not amend the agreement.
